Get ahead by earning 10X Points^ on online and shopping purchases with Citi Rewards Card, then offset these purchases with Citi Pay with Points – that’s how you shop 10X smarter!
How do I earn 10X Points with the Citi Rewards Card?
Earn 10X Citi ThankYou SM Points on eligible online purchases ^ and in-store shopping purchases ^ with your Citi Rewards Card.
You will earn 1 Base Point and 9 Bonus Points for every S$1 spent on eligible 10X Points transactions ^ .
What online purchases can earn 10X Points?
You can earn 10X Points on eligible online purchases ^ such as online grocery, food delivery, ride-hailing and more .
Certain transactions, including mobile wallet and travel-related transactions, may not qualify for 10X Points.
What in store shopping purchases can earn 10X Points?
You can earn 10X Points on eligible in-store shopping purchases ^ at selected merchants, including department stores, clothing stores and other qualifying retail merchants .
What do I earn on purchases that do not qualify for 10X Points?
For purchases that do not qualify for 10X Points, you will earn 1 Citi ThankYou SM Point for every S$1 spent on eligible transactions ^ .
However, Bonus Points from 10X Points eligible transactions ^ are capped at 9,000 Bonus Points per statement month .
